record.bible_text: The wilderness<WH04057> and the solitary place<WH06723> shall be glad<WH07797><WTH8799> for them; and the desert<WH06160> shall rejoice<WH01523><WTH8799>, and blossom<WH06524><WTH8799> as the rose<WH02261>.
